description: List every numeric fact in one filing's XBRL exactly as filed: standard and filer-specific extension concepts, consolidated values and every value broken out by segment, product, geography or other axis (paginated). Not normalized or comparable across companies.

accession_id.description: EDGAR accession of the filing, e.g. 0000320193-25-000079 (from filings.list).

axes.description: Optional axes; keep only values broken out by at least one of them.

concepts.description: Optional concepts to keep, qualified or bare (any prefix).

dimensioned.description: Optional: false keeps only consolidated values, true only breakdowns.

taxonomies.description: Optional concept prefixes to keep, e.g. us-gaap or the filer's own.

name: filings_facts
